policy: Standing long-jump practice may contain demonstrations, partial repetitions and slow motion. Do not infer jump distance or success. Arm and leg phases may overlap.

terms.label: arm_backswing
terms.definition: Arms visibly travel rearward during preparation. Held arms behind the trunk are a pose, not ongoing swing.

terms.label: countermovement
terms.definition: Observable hip/knee flexion and lowered body before an attempted jump; do not infer muscle force.

terms.label: arm_forward_swing
terms.definition: Arms travel forward/upward. Can overlap leg extension and takeoff.

terms.label: push_off
terms.definition: Visible hip/knee/ankle extension toward ground separation. Include a ground-separation anchor only if visible.

terms.label: flight
terms.definition: Feet visibly unsupported by the ground, from takeoff through the approach to landing. Do not infer flight from a camera cut.

terms.label: landing_preparation
terms.definition: Observable lower-limb repositioning preparing landing during flight; specify the actual sequence.

terms.label: landing
terms.definition: First visible ground contact and subsequent absorbing flexion; the initial contact may be uncertain.

terms.label: recovery
terms.definition: Post-landing steps or rebalancing toward stable standing, distinguished from the landing phase.
